pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: clients/typescript/src/index.ts:421 On startup the journal recovery closes calls left open by a killed process as status=error. Their unknown outcome is carried only in a tag and an explanatory error string, so error-rate alerting and anything else that branches on status counts an indeterminate call as a definite failure.

techniques.evidence: clients/typescript/src/index.ts:421 The recovered call is closed with a definite failure verdict, and the indeterminacy is recovered from RECOVERED_TAG (journal.ts:47) and unsettledError() prose. The vocabulary has no first-class indeterminate status. The tag is better than message matching but still sits beside a false status.

clients/typescript/src/index.ts:387 In the wrapper, the admission gate (lt.gate) runs before the recorder and can refuse a call by throwing. The refused call is recorded only when recordBlocked is set (index.ts:592), so by default the ledger has gaps on exactly the refused calls.

clients/typescript/src/instrument.ts:172 A frame that does not enter the continuation throws a typed refusal (LightTrackBudgetExceeded) and never fabricates a provider-shaped result. Every returned value comes from the real provider call.

pairs.registryProposal: semantic-hook-placement says a recorder must sit outside every gate that can answer a call. It does not address the case here: the ledger write is itself metered against the cap that refused the call, which is why the SDK defaults recordBlocked off. The technique could say whether a refused-call record must be exempt from the cap it reports on, rather than optional.

pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: crates/store/src/sqlite/jobs.rs:127 A job whose worker died is reclaimed straight back to 'running' and re-issued, with 'worker lost' stamped only as error prose. Expired relay leases are likewise re-leased or set to 'dead' carrying the device-lost string (relay.rs:130). Interrupted metered work is therefore re-run or closed as a failure, never closed as indeterminate.

techniques.evidence: crates/store/src/sqlite/jobs.rs:127 Recovery writes a distinguishing sentence (JOB_ERROR_WORKER_LOST / RELAY_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST) instead of an indeterminate status. It also silently re-issues metered generation work instead of closing it and reconciling spend. Counting stale_reclaims on its own key (jobs.rs:126) is conformant with the technique's restart-counting rule.
